items.rationale: The inspection to establish cause and extent is covered under 5.2.6(b), separately from leak location, and the estimated €500 gross is below its €3,000 cap. The €500 deductible under 4.7 and 7.8 applies once to the aggregate event indemnity, not to this line alone.
Section 5.2.6(a) covers locating the porous leaks. An estimated €450 for the survey plus €160 for separately itemised technician time is below the shared €1,000 event cap, so no proration is needed.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers on-site technician time to the extent it is not already included in the survey fee under 7.1.8(c). At €64 gross per hour, 2.5 hours total €160, within the shared leak-location cap.
Section 5.2.6(c) permits one vehicle charge on this contractor's invoice. The estimated €78 gross is below the €70 net cap, equivalent to €83.30 gross at 19% VAT.

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) treats ageing-related leakage as fracture damage for sections proven to leak, and 9.1.1 does not treat age alone as a breach. Allow €250 gross under 7.1.1(b) for local sealing or renewal of the two joints, not replacement of the run.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking pipe run
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) expressly excludes aged sections not shown to leak, and 7.1.8(a) excludes preventive renewal. No part of this line is payable on the stated facts.
Section 7.1.9 limits indemnity to the pre-loss specification. This line bills only the upgrade difference, so it contains no payable like-for-like repair cost.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on the plumber's own invoice because the journey served the covered joint repair. The estimated €78 gross is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.
